subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus source-level positive/negative coverage as sufficient proof for this provider-side xAI rotation error, or keep requiring after-fix Grok/gateway evidence before merge?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot mark an external PR's proof sufficient without after-fix real behavior evidence, but the contributor provided a concrete reason the exact xAI code-less decrypt error is provider-side and not client-inducible on demand.

options.title: Accept explicit proof override
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the pre-fix production logs and source-level coverage as enough for this narrow predicate change, then apply a proof override before merge.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until xAI emits the same stale encrypted_content rotation error again and the contributor can attach redacted recovery logs or live output from this branch.

options.title: Prefer broader retry work first
options.body: Pause this PR and decide whether the broader retry-family work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95587 should land first or replace this narrow matcher.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit proof override
recommendation.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the pre-fix production logs and source-level coverage as enough for this narrow predicate change, then apply a proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged same-predicate retry change in PR 92941 and has already handled adjacent OpenAI Responses encrypted-replay recovery decisions.
